text_block_list.text: This year's Arima Kinen is right before our eyes.

Because of that, even after returning to my room
I'd stay up late planning menus
and devising race strategies, but—
(RATATATATATAT!!)
(RAT-TAT-TAT-TAT-TAT!!)
(K-K-K-K-KRAAAAAASHH!!)

Out of nowhere, an extraordinary
impact sound began echoing all around...!!
I have absolutely no idea what's going on!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Phew, managed to sneak in somehow...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shh, hey! Keep your voice down!
They're gonna find out we accidentally broke in!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I went at the wall with, like, files, drills, chainsaws, and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Well, I just gave it a good *crunch, crack, snap*, so don't worry."

"I wonder what the wall looks like right now...
......I don't want to look."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's your own fault for not having a chimney ready, though.
Besides, you're leaning way too hard into acting surprised.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You ought to be more thrilled.
A pretty girl just broke into your place in the dead of night. Packed with all kinds of tools, no less.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, people these days sure crumble easily under pressure~

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So here ya go. A present from Santa Golshi. You better forge a mind of steel, got it?
I was handed something hefty and heavy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Tamahagane.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If your mentality is weak, at least arm yourself.
I can make you all the swords and armor you want, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well then, excuse me.
—Have a Merry Christmas.

"I have no idea what the proper way to react
to this situation is, but..."

I couldn't help but wonder about the wall
that had supposedly been wrecked by drills and chainsaws...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about spoiled~. If normies heard that,
they'd be crying with envy.

I feel like this goes way beyond
just having "no social life"...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, hey,
does someone live upstairs?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No, I just figured we'd get into trouble
if somebody was actually living there, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—If we drill a hole in the ceiling
and stick a fir tree through it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Brought a huge fir tree with me.
Let's punch a hole through the ceiling and plant it right here.

The fir tree Gold Ship prepared for us
apparently stands a full 30 meters tall—
After politely declining to put it in my own room, I donated it to the academy's Christmas event.
